design: Keep the original five-native-sample decoder and disjoint 50-step windows. Reset thinning phase to each window start, keep both boundary labels exactly, and drop only interior labels. Fit both rate candidates on calibration trace 0 and predict all scored observations. Repeats 1 and 2 were previously scored; repeats 3 and 4 are additional acquisitions at the recorded setting.
criterion: The denominators and endpoint counts must agree exactly across nested grids. Attribute disagreement in sampled departure counts to windows with fine-grid changes and no retained departure. Compare observed and predicted loss and contrast the two fixed calibration lag fits without using the scored traces to choose a winner.
